The present claim proceedings have emanated from Detailed Accident Report, (hereinafter referred to as DAR), as filed on 06.06.2017, with reference to FIR No. 490/16, registered at PS Begumpur, Delhi, in respect of simple hurt, sustained by the petitioner namely Master Darsh Gupta,
in a road traffic accident, on 22.07.2016, at about 7.15 am, at side road, Pocket-11, Sector-21, Rohini,
Delhi.

Subsequently, chargesheet was filed by the IO, against Vikas S/o Sh. Jagmal Singh (hereinafter referred to as Page 4 of40 Master Darsh Gupta vs. Vikas and ors. Whether on 22.07.2016 at about 7.15 am, at Pocket-11, Sector-21, Rohini, Delhi, one Mahindra Pick up bearing registration no. DL-1LM-0918, which was being driven rashly and negligently by Vikas an hit Eeco Van bearing registration No.
